metadata.description: Claude Code plan usage and named-login switching, in any MCP client: the claude-usage plugin from claude-usage-panel.

plugins.name: claude-usage
plugins.description: Ask Claude for your plan usage and switch accounts in-conversation: get_usage returns session, weekly, and per-model limits from the official Anthropic usage endpoint; list_accounts / save_account / switch_account manage named Claude Code logins (PRO, PERSO) without a browser.
